Name: Joja Bus Rebrand (Seasonal)
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
[b]Introducing the Joja Bus Rebrand![/b]

Pelican Town’s bus service has finally been restored, and JojaCorp was proud to help. After repairing the bus, JojaCorp made a few minor branding updates to ensure every trip to the desert is efficient, profitable, and legally associated with Joja.

This mod replaces the repaired bus with a Joja-themed version, complete with corporate colors and Joja branding.

A separate Community Center route version is available under optional file. Please install only one version at a time.

[b]Features[/b]
Recolors the repaired bus with a Joja-inspired design. 
Only appears after the Joja route bus repair (or CC vault completion if installing CC route).
Patches only the bus sprites. 
Does not change the bus price, function, schedule, or gameplay. 
This mod does not affect the broken bus before repair.

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI
Content Patcher

[b]Install[/b]
Install the required mods.
Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
Launch the game with SMAPI.

[b]Troubleshooting:
[/b]
This mod checks how your bus was repaired, and not necessarily which overall route you finished later.
If your bus was repaired through the Community Center Vault, your save uses the Community Center bus repair flag. Even if you later continue or finish through Joja, the Joja-only version will not activate for that save.
Use the Community Center version instead if your bus was originally repaired through the Community Center Vault.
Please install only one version at a time.
